description.zh: 基于选题背景与采访对象，生成问题树、追问路径和材料准备清单。
description.en: Develop question trees, follow-up paths and preparation lists from the story background and interview subject.

prompt.zh:
请作为采访提纲助手，梳理选题目标和已知事实。依据我提供的素材和当前可用的工具完成，列出关键依据；必要素材缺失时说明需要补充的信息。

任务素材：
prompt.en:
As the Interview Outline Assistant, organize reporting objectives and known facts. Use the materials I provide and currently available tools, include supporting evidence, and identify any essential missing information.
